title: Primitives
description: Authoritative base primitive definitions for the trading system.

DecimalString.description: Arbitrary-precision decimal represented as a string. Binary floats are forbidden.

TimestampISO.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with exactly millisecond precision.

NonNegativeIntegerString.description: Unbounded non-negative integer represented as a canonical decimal string.

UUIDv7.description: Canonical lowercase UUIDv7 string for time-ordered identifiers.

MarketId.description: Canonical market identifier according to DEC-053.

EngineType.description: Deterministic strategy engine type according to DEC-014.

CandidateGrade.description: Deterministic candidate quality grade according to DEC-017.

JudgeDecisionType.description: Conditional analytical judge verdict according to DEC-006.

OrderStatus.description: Lifecycle status of an order according to DEC-051.
